label: Acquired by
description: e2 purchases controlling stake in e1. The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by the same relation type.

label: Brand of
description: e2 offers products or services of e1 (Brand). The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by the same relation type.

label: Client of
description: e1 uses (and presumably pays for) products or services offered by e2. The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by “Supplier of”.

label: Collaboration
description: e1 and e2 collaborate in (parts of their) business activities. The relation is undirected.

label: Merged with
description: e1 and e2 merged (parts of) their business activities. The relation is undirected.

label: Product or service of
description: e1 is offered for commercial distribution by e2. The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by the same relation type.

label: Shareholder of
description: e1 owns shares in e2. The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by the same relation type.

label: Subsidiary of
description: e2 legally owns e1. The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by “Parent of”.

label: Traded on
description: Shares of e1 are listed on e2 (Stock exchange). The relation is directed. The inverted relation is best described by “lists”.
